# Primary sources for USPTO post-grant proceedings

> Official public-record texts cited by the insight stories at postgrantproceeding.com: statutes, the Code of Federal Regulations, MPEP sections, PTAB and Director decisions, federal court opinions, Federal Register rules, and USPTO notices. United States government works in this collection are not subject to copyright. Phase 1 only.
